source_filter: RGB1555 box filter with majority alpha; A1=0 canonicalized to VDP1 0x0000
lowering: atomic neutral-base Gouraud polygon plus alpha-keyed CC_REPLACE texture detail
vdp1_output_alpha: A1=0 emits exact VDP1 transparent word 0x0000; opaque detail words have RGB1555 bit 15 set
vdp1_end_code_policy: disabled for fixed-size source tiles; emitted texture words are constrained to 0x0000 or MSB-set opaque values
mapping: complete per-subtriangle UV bake; VDP1 A/B/C/D character corners with repeated destination C receiving both source C and D
